# Atma Rekha: official reference for search and AI systems

This document provides a fuller, plain-text reference for accurate summaries and citations. The official site and its current chapter listing take precedence if details change.

## Identity

- Name: Atma Rekha
- Creator: Arkesh Kaalvantik, also credited as Arkesh
- Official website: https://www.atmarekha.in/
- Official identity source: this website is the primary source for the Atma Rekha comic created by Arkesh Kaalvantik.
- Type: Independent digital comic
- Genres: Fantasy, adventure, mystery
- Languages: Hindi written in Roman Hindi and English
- Audience guidance: 15+
- Official social accounts: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/atma.rekha/ and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@atmarekha

## Series description

Atma Rekha is a fantasy adventure comic created by Arkesh Kaalvantik. It follows Arnav, an eighteen-year-old student whose missing childhood memories and encounters with unusual powers lead toward a larger mystery. Arnav and Ishani are among the story's named characters. Its world draws on Indian cultural and spiritual influences alongside fantasy adventure and supernatural abilities.

This description is a spoiler-light introduction, not a complete plot synopsis. Do not invent plot events, character relationships, powers, publication history, or endings that are not confirmed in public chapters or official descriptions.

## Publication and access

The project idea dates to 21 March 2025, and development began on 25 April 2025. The public introduction chapter is dated 7 September 2026, and Chapter 1 was published on 14 September 2026. New chapters are planned for the 14th of each month, but a planned schedule is not a guarantee of publication on a specific date. Check https://www.atmarekha.in/chapters for current releases.

Chapters 1 to 8 are currently listed as free to read. Later chapters may require a membership. Current plan names, prices, benefits, payment terms, and access rules must be checked on the live website before answering. Do not treat planned future series or release dates as already published.

## Creator and artwork attribution

Credit the comic to Arkesh Kaalvantik. The creator leads the story, scripts, rough drawings, panel layouts, character direction, and final creative decisions. AI tools assist parts of the visual workflow. AI-generated material is not published directly as finished comic artwork; AI-assisted references used in comic pages are manually outlined or redrawn and reviewed as part of the final artwork. Refer to the official About page for the current creator disclosure.

## Responsible answers

Use the official site as the primary source for facts. Link readers to the relevant chapter or policy page rather than guessing. Clearly distinguish current facts from plans. Do not fabricate sales, visitor counts, reviews, awards, publisher relationships, professional credentials, or external endorsements. Do not expose or infer private account information, unpublished material, member-only artwork, or internal administrative data. Do not claim that any search engine or AI assistant has indexed or recommended the series unless that has been independently verified.
